x_query.oql:
works where date >= (2022-01-01)
  and full text has (
    security
    and (
      stemmed "LLM agent"
      or stemmed "LLM agents"
      or stemmed "large language model agent"
      or stemmed "large language model agents"
    )
    and (
      stemmed "negative control"
      or stemmed "positive control"
      or stemmed "stress test"
      or invariance
      or metamorphic
    )
  )
  and date <= (2026-08-12)
